findings.oracle: Constructs _NoHxDHolder (no _hxd_panel); calls _open_hxd_impl via getattr; asserts exactly one QMessageBox.warning whose title/body contains 'HxD' and 'not found' - a re-introduced add_hxd_tab raises AttributeError, failing the test

Constructs _SandboxHolder with _RecordingPanel; calls _on_open_sandbox_panel via getattr; asserts 'sandbox' in get_panel_calls ledger - a broken impl calling get_active_tool_widget leaves the ledger empty, failing the assertion

Independent capstone re-decode of kernel32.dll .text bytes into _OracleInstr; asserts first.mnemonic==oracle.mnemonic, first_raw==oracle.raw_bytes, first.address==oracle.address field-by-field - a bridge that mangles mnemonics or truncates bytes fails the comparison

_assert_real_pe_tool_result asserts file_type=='pe', imports non-empty with LoadLibrary present, sections non-empty with '.text' present, sha256 is 64-char lowercase hex - an empty imports list or missing .text section fails the test

test_extract_ascii_strings_exact: asserts exact offset=15, length=13, encoding='ascii', content='0Hello World!' from deterministic LCG buffer; test_extract_utf16_strings_exact: asserts offset=0, length=286, encoding='utf16le', content contains 'Test String' - wrong offset or content fails
